name: last_final_sudoku_hard_benchmark
description: A collection of hard Sudoku puzzles intended to evaluate solvers and learning agents on high-difficulty instances. Each sample provides a starting grid and the expected completed solution; the benchmark measures whether a model/agent can produce the correct full solution under strict correctness criteria. Useful for testing algorithmic reasoning, search, and reinforcement-learning-based solvers.
reputation: Small, specialized Hugging Face benchmark used primarily in solver and RL experimentation rather than broad community benchmarks.
